svg.title: Four Gates Under SOP 50 10 8.1
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-sba-acquisition-gates; chapter number: 5; title: Four Gates Under SOP 50 10 8.1; subtitle: Historical cash flow sets the ceiling on acquisition debt; chart type: decision_tree; nodes: gate: G1; question: Do supported historical earnings cover debt service at 1.25x or better?; pass next: G2; fail action: Reprice or walk; $700K claimed that shrinks to $550K against $500K of debt service is 1.10x and fails the floor.; gate: G2; question: If the price net of appraised owner-occupied real estate is $3M or more, is a lender-commissioned or vendor-reviewed QoE in hand?; pass next: G3; fail action: Order the QoE with the lender as the client; quotes run $5,000 to $30,000.; gate: G3; question: Is the 10% injection seasoned for two full bank statement cycles, with any HELOC paired to an outside repayment source?; pass next: G4; fail action: Season the cash first, or pair borrowed money with outside income such as a spouse's W-2.; gate: G4; question: Will the seller sign a full-standby note with no principal or interest for the life of the loan, covering no more than half the injection?; pass next: Close; on a $1.15M project that is $57,500 of buyer cash plus a $57,500 standby note.; fail action: Fund the full 10% injection in buyer cash; the old zero-cash structure is gone.; caption: Lenders, brokers and CPAs agree the DSCR floor, the $3M QoE trigger, injection seasoning and seller standby terms now decide whether an SBA deal closes.; assumptions note: Gates follow the practitioner examples quoted; how the $3M trigger is measured and whether a buyer QoE can be reused remain disputed among practitioners.; note: Attributed to Pioneer Capital Advisory LLC (WF2-6ODNQms at 00:06:24 and 00:32:42), Lion Business Advisors (orHTcAJcuAM at 00:07:05 and 00:15:11), SBA Ray (9Sl18GknuZE at 00:04:31) and Exit Ready Valuation (Tt3Ae9PDn8A at 00:00:54 and 00:01:15).

circle.title: gate: G1; question: Do supported historical earnings cover debt service at 1.25x or better?; pass next: G2; fail action: Reprice or walk; $700K claimed that shrinks to $550K against $500K of debt service is 1.10x and fails the floor.

gate: G2; question: If the price net of appraised owner-occupied real estate is $3M or more, is a lender-commissioned or vendor-reviewed QoE in hand?; pass next: G3; fail action: Order the QoE with the lender as the client; quotes run $5,000 to $30,000.

gate: G3; question: Is the 10% injection seasoned for two full bank statement cycles, with any HELOC paired to an outside repayment source?; pass next: G4; fail action: Season the cash first, or pair borrowed money with outside income such as a spouse's W-2.

gate: G4; question: Will the seller sign a full-standby note with no principal or interest for the life of the loan, covering no more than half the injection?; pass next: Close; on a $1.15M project that is $57,500 of buyer cash plus a $57,500 standby note.; fail action: Fund the full 10% injection in buyer cash; the old zero-cash structure is gone.

text.title: Assumptions: Gates follow the practitioner examples quoted; how the $3M trigger is measured and whether a buyer QoE can be reused remain disputed among practitioners.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Gates follow the practitioner examples quoted; how the $3M trigger is measured and whether a buyer QoE can be reused
